children: Toronto, Ontario--(Newsfile Corp. - November 13, 2026) - Caprock Mining Corp. (CSE: CAPR) ("
") is pleased to announce that it has entered into an investor relations agreement with Epstein Research ("

") to increase investor engagement and awareness. ER's engagement is for an initial term of three months, commencing November 15, 2026 and ending February 15, 2027, and may be renewed or cancelled in accordance with the terms of the Agreement.
Under the terms of the Agreement, ER will provide promotional services, including social media and online advertising regarding the Company posted on the ER homepage (

), CEO.ca, Substack and LinkedIn; monthly written articles on the Company and/or CEO interviews written exclusively by Peter Epstein; and online commentary on the Company on websites including CEO.ca, Stockhouse, TalkMarkets, LinkedIn, Twitter/X, Yahoo Finance, Facebook, YouTube and StockTwits.

ER is a research and analysis firm wholly owned and operated by Peter Epstein, specializing in investor engagement and market awareness for public companies. As consideration for the services, the Company will pay ER an aggregate cash fee of US$6,000. The Company will not issue any securities, including options to purchase securities, to ER as compensation. ER and its principal are arm's length to the Company and do not have any interest, direct or indirect, in the Company or its securities, nor do they have any right to acquire such an interest. ER is located at 31 Goldfinch Drive, Upper Saddle River, NJ 07458, and can be contacted at epstein.peter4@gmail.com or (845) 304-7386.
Caprock Mining Corp. is a Canadian mineral exploration company focused on exploring precious metals in Quebec and Ontario.
The Company has an option to earn a 100% interest in the Destiny gold property (the "

") that comprises 127 mineral claims and encompasses an area of 5,013 hectares located less than two hours' drive from Val d'Or, Quebec. Destiny lies along a major deformation corridor in the Abitibi greenstone belt that includes the prolific Cadillac-Larder Lake, Destor-Porcupine and Casa Berardi fault zones, which host numerous producing and development-stage gold deposits. The Property overlies a 6.0 km long segment of the poorly explored Despinassy shear zone, which is a splay off the regional Chicobi Fault. Destiny hosts a significant, open pit-constrained, NI 43-101-compliant Mineral Resource Estimate published in March 2025.
